messages.subject: Reading imzML files in
parts:
Dear Cardinal MSI help,

I have been having this error message when I try to load in imzML files obtained from conversion of .msi files using mzML files and waters pattern file.

Error: readImzML: m/z values must be positive for units.accuracy='ppm'

The command at https://rdrr.io/github/Bioconductor-mirror/Cardinal/man/readMSIData.html does not seem to work either.

Kind regards,
Shadrack

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Reading imzML files in
parts:
Hi Shadrack,

This is caused by having spectra with measurements at 0 m/z, which causes errors during certain calculations required during import when using "units.accuracy='ppm'" (the default). Try using "units.accuracy='mz'" instead. This will set a fixed bin size rather than an adaptive one. Make sure to change "mass.accuracy=" to your desired bin size, since the default doesn't make sense for m/z units.

-Kylie
